Hi,

Probably an installation issue.

a) Do you have permissions to run local jobs? Then try
z=rhmr(map=m,reduce=r,comb=T,inout=c("text","sequence"),ifolder="/root/test1",ofolder='/root/out')

rhex(z,mapred=list(mapred.job.tracker='local'))

b) Also, on the worker nodes try this

R_HOME=/ln/meraki/custom/lib64/R/ RHIPEWHAT=0 RHIPELOGFILE="/tmp/x"
rhipe_outputformat_class=foo rhipe_combiner=0
/ln/meraki/custom/lib64/R/library/Rhipe/libs/imperious.so

Does (b) work (i.e does it )?

Change R_HOME (you can get it by typing R.home() in R) and change the
path of imperious to where Rhipe is located
R
library(Rhipe)
rhoptions()$runner[1]

Saptarshi
